title: fix(studio): a state-machine row in the validations panel can say its state may be cleared
body:
Fixes #36567
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio 的校验规则面板里编辑状态机时，每一行流转多了一个「可清空」勾选框；改动前后其它界面不变。
- 为什么做：状态机规则把清空状态字段算作一次流转，只有勾了「可清空」的状态才允许；以前面板写不出这个设置，编辑已有规则时还会把它悄悄删掉，用户随后清空字段就被拒绝。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个状态的「可清空」设置被写错，用户清空字段时被误拒或误放行；不涉及数据丢失，可直接撤回本次合并。
- 无。

## What changes

`TransitionsField` in `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` parsed a row's next states with `.split(',').map(trim).filter(Boolean)`, so the empty-string target (a clear of the field, allowed from that state since PR #36127) could never be authored, and any edit to a row that already listed it dropped it. The display side lost it too: `['open', '']` rendered as `open, ` and `['']` as an empty box.

Now:

- The "Next states" box shows and edits the named targets only.
- Each row has a "May be cleared" checkbox (zh: 可清空, with a hover hint) that adds or removes the `''` target.
- Editing the box keeps an existing `''`; it is written as the row's last target (targets are a set), so `paused: ['open', '']` is written back unchanged.

Measured against the dispatch's mechanism hypotheses: the parse in the targets box is the only parse site in the panel (`split(` occurs once in the file at 9348f02b); the display side (`to.join(', ')`) also lost the `''` and is fixed in the same change. Nothing changes on the server or in the spec (ADR-0020 D1/D3 shape and enforcement unchanged).

New strings: `engine.studio.rules.transitionClearable` and `engine.studio.rules.transitionClearableHint` in the studio namespace's `en` and `zh` catalogues (the only two that namespace ships; it is not a zh-Hant generation target).

## Tests

New pin: `ObjectValidationsPanel.clearableState-36567.test.tsx`.

- "a rule with paused: ['open', ''] round-trips through a row edit unchanged": the box shows `open`, the row's checkbox is checked; an edit to `open, closed` writes `['open', 'closed', '']`, and an edit back to `open` writes the original `transitions` map exactly. Each written rule passes a full `ValidationRuleSchema.safeParse`.
- "the checkbox adds and removes the empty-string target".

 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (259e85f4d6e5) and `git diff HEAD` is empty

Observed as predicted: the round-trip case went red and the checkbox case stayed green. The subject is imported from source, so no build leg was needed.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Landing point is the expected one (`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`) plus its two catalogue files. No edit under the fenced trees.
- Not run locally, and declared to CI's `Test UI`: the full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite. A local run held the shared verification lock for more than 35 minutes without finishing and was stopped. The panel's own 13 suites, the preview suite and the i18n package ran green.
- Out of scope, reported to the seat and not fixed here: (1) a comma typed at the end of the "Next states" box is eaten. The controlled box re-renders from the parsed list, so typing `done, c` key by key leaves `donec`. A throwaway probe confirmed this at 26b38360; the base runs the same parse expression. The cause is the same parse expression, but the fix (a text buffer) is a design change. (2) The metadata-admin validation preview renders an `''` target as a trailing ` | ` (`open | `), or as a blank where neither a target nor "dead end" shows (`closed → `). A throwaway probe confirmed it.
